project_name: The Alchemical Lexicon — Transmutations of the Living Word
theme: Steampunk Alchemical Laboratory / Scholarly Victorian Curiosity Shop
target_audience: Precocious 7-Year-Old (High Reading Fluency, Pattern-Seeking, Systems Thinker)
core_educational_focus: Morphology, Etymology, Semantic Nuance, Word Networks
design_archetype: Organic & Earthy + Steampunk Precision + Arcane Mystery

headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight font-serif text-amber-100 drop-shadow-[0_2px_10px_rgba(212,175,55,0.3)]
headings.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold font-serif text-amber-200 tracking-tight

morpheme_runes.prefix: font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-300 bg-blue-950/80 border border-blue-500/50 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(59,130,246,0.3)]
morpheme_runes.root: font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-300 bg-amber-950/80 border border-amber-500/50 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(245,158,11,0.3)]
morpheme_runes.suffix: font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-300 bg-emerald-950/80 border border-emerald-500/50 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(16,185,129,0.3)]

layout_and_structure.viewports: Desktop-first optimized experience with full responsive fallbacks for tablets and mobile devices.

alchemists_workbench.container: relative w-full min-h-screen bg-[#0B0D12] text-slate-100 overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between p-4 md:p-8
alchemists_workbench.reagent_drawers: wooden carved panel with brass filigree edges, hosting draggable morpheme runic tiles.
alchemists_workbench.alembic_crucible: central glass flask with liquid particle effects, animated bubbles, magnetic snapping zone for tiles, and glowing brass rim.
alchemists_workbench.brass_microphone_horn: Web Speech API voice incantation button rendered as an interactive victorian brass horn with acoustic audio wave animations.

layout_and_structure.philosophers_tree: Radial constellation map using SVG and HTML5 Canvas, rendered with glowing star nodes, connecting golden energy beams, and clickable word family branches.
layout_and_structure.grand_alchemical_bestiary: Illustrated grimoire modal with leather texture frame, ribbon bookmarks, dual page spreads, and word collection badges.

steampunk_elements: Glowing runic etchings on morpheme tiles
Gilded copper borders with corner filigrees
Steam exhaust animations upon successful transmutation
Acoustic brass horn microphone glow ring

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based, explicit. Mandatory for all draggable tiles, crucible dropzone, voice microphone button, navigation tabs, trial answer cards, and grimoire pages.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Javascript (.js / .jsx) components only, not TypeScript (.tsx).

Build a immersive single-page alchemical laboratory app with tab views or modal overlays for Crucible Workbench, Philosopher's Tree (3 constellations: Rule & Order, Light & Vision, Form & Change), Alchemist's Trials, and Grand Bestiary Grimoire.
Implement Morpheme Tile drag and drop using HTML5 Drag & Drop or Framer Motion with magnetic drop-zone feedback into the Alembic Flask.
Integrate Web Speech API (SpeechRecognition) for the Brass Horn Voice Incantation button with simulated fallback if voice is unsupported or denied.
Ensure high visual contrast and scholarly tone; treat the child player as a serious young inventor/alchemist.
